scripts.dev: node_modules/.bin/tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json && concurrently "node_modules/.bin/tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --watch" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: node_modules/.bin/tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
